title: Yoga timetable becomes a window decal
brief:
Client: Pebble Moon Yoga; contact robin@example.com.
Design one A4 class timetable using the supplied schedule.
Supply one print-ready PDF and one 1080 × 1350 px JPEG of that timetable.
One revision round covers corrections to class times and text.
First proof is due 21 October; approved files are due 25 October.
Out of scope: signage, window decals and new illustrations.
message: The timetable looks lovely, thank you. Could you also design a window decal with our opening hours? We can send measurements tomorrow.

expected_items.anchor: design a window decal with our opening hours
